_comment: Example plan for the 25 s Acme film in palette 3, 'Minimal piano and space' (references/05a-score-styles.md). Choose the palette per film with the user. Chunk text <= 200 chars; 3000-120000 ms per chunk; durations sum to (end_s - start_s) * 1000; same boundaries across plans so takes can be cut together; never name artists; always exclude vocals.

A.concept: Minimal piano and space: calm, premium, lets the product breathe.

chunks.text: [Many ideas] {Instrumental. Out of near silence, a close felt piano plays a few soft single notes with lots of space between them.}
[Acme remembers] {Instrumental. The piano finds a simple four note figure and repeats it, a little warmer, a soft low note underneath.}
[Already there] {Instrumental. The figure opens into gentle chords, the fullest moment, then settles on one warm held chord that rings out.}
